title: Custom Beer and Wine Tour of Sonoma and Napa from San Francisco
includes: Round trip Golden Gate Bridge itinerary
Pre-travel consultation to plan and customize group's itinerary and wine tour experience
Optional group photograph service on North Point of the Golden Gate Bridge
Visit to Inexpensive Tastings at Wineries available
Pickup and drop-off from hotels/residence within city of San Francisco
OPTIONAL: Extra time: after first 8 hours - (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Several vehicle options to accommodate parties of up to 21 persons
Reservations larger than 7 persons should contact supplier for additional details per group size.
List of Breweries will also be provided by supplier after booking
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This Brewery and Winery tour will take you to the best wineries as well as the most iconic breweries in North Bay's Sonoma County. Our years of experience in quality wine and brew touring has allowed us to share the best kept secrets in value for those visiting the wine capital of California. 
- Embark on a delightful wine tour starting from San Francisco, with the first stop at the Palace of Fine Arts, where the picturesque architecture sets a perfect backdrop for the day's adventure. Next, we cross the iconic Golden Gate Bridge, pausing at the North End at Fort Baker - an ideal photo opportunity to capture its grandeur. As we soak in the stunning scenery, sparkling wine is served, setting a festive tone for the day ahead. 
Tour is fully customized based on client's preferences.
- All stops are optional.
- Extra large SUV
